Since I still have no repository access in this environment, my job is to produce an architecturally sound, verifiable-shaped design (repository abstraction, schema, dual-write/cutover sequencing, rollback) while being explicit about what is assumed vs. what requires source verification — not fabricate concrete file paths as fact.
